claims.claim: You can apply for a visa to come to the UK online.
claims.quote: Prepare any evidence and documents you need for your application. Apply online.
claims.note: The visa application guide explicitly instructs applicants to apply online.

claims.claim: A valid passport is needed for a visa application.
claims.quote: usually have a valid passport or travel document
claims.note: The guide says a valid passport or travel document is usually needed, so a passport is not an unconditional requirement.

claims.claim: Financial evidence showing sufficient funds is needed for a visa application.
claims.quote: proof you have enough money to support yourself and pay for your course - this will vary depending on your circumstances
claims.note: The Student visa page supports this for some applicants, but it does not establish a requirement for every visa route.

claims.claim: A Skilled Worker visa requires a confirmed job offer.
claims.quote: You must have a confirmed job offer before you apply for your visa.
claims.note: The Skilled Worker visa page states this requirement.

claims.claim: A Skilled Worker visa requires a certificate of sponsorship from the employer.
claims.quote: have a ‘certificate of sponsorship’ ( CoS ) from your employer with information about the role you’ve been offered in the UK
claims.note: The Skilled Worker visa page states this requirement.

claims.claim: A Student visa application requires a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies from the course provider.
claims.quote: a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies ( CAS ) from your course provider
claims.note: The Student visa page lists this among the documents applicants must provide.

claims.claim: A visa application for a dependant can require evidence of the relationship.
claims.quote: You’ll need to provide evidence of your relationship when you apply, for example:
claims.note: The Student visa page specifies this evidence for dependants.
